title: fix(skills): four objectstack-platform eval cases agree with their own must_not_contain assertions

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi8irujFEnBnqcKvK4Kv1YDL)_
Fixes #27455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 四个用例(1、2、4、7)的标准答案与自身的 `must_not_contain` 断言不再互斥——用例 1 的断言收窄为键拼法 `tableName:`;用例 2、4、7 的标准答案改写警句,不再逐字拼出被拒字串。另加一张 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。
- 为什么改:这份评测文件既是标准答案又是评分器;四个用例的标准答案逐字命中自己的拒收串,逐字写出理想答案会被判错,平台技能在配置、插件、运维题上的质量信号因此是噪声。
- 风险与回滚:只动一份评测 fixture 与一张 changeset,不动 SKILL.md、规则、spec 或任何运行时;无断言被删除,文件缩 13 token、天花板不动。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 用例 7 的 `expected_output`(两处改写:`role` 去冒号、具名平台集改为「no platform set」),其次用例 1 的 `tableName:` 收窄,再次用例 2。
- 两分钟验证:仓根跑 `python3 -c 'import json;d=json.load(open("skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json"));[print(e["id"],[s for s in e["assertions"].get("must_not_contain",[]) if s in e["expected_output"]]) for e in d["evals"]]'`,预期九行、每行的列表都是空的 `[]`(main 上第 1、2、4、7 行非空)。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(`skills/**`)——`GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 账号一次 APPROVED review,其后由席位落地。

## What changes

One shipped fixture, `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` (ships in `@objectstack/skills`), and one patch changeset. Each of the four cases was judged from the skill text, per the card's Wanted: drop the refused literal from the reference answer when the answer only names it to warn, or narrow the assertion to the wrong form it was meant to catch.

| eval | refused string spelled in its own answer | judged from | fix |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `tableName` | `SKILL.md` line 116 ("never set `tableName`"; also AGENTS.md Prime Directive 6) — the skill's own warning uses the bare word; the wrong form is the object key | assertion narrowed to the key spelling `tableName:`, the form its siblings `workflows:` / `approvals:` already use; reference answer unchanged |
| 2 | `data:beforeInsert`, `onInstall` | `references/plugin-hooks.md` lines 73–76 (a `'data:beforeInsert'` handler on the kernel bus registers and silently never fires); AGENTS.md Plugin pattern (the contract is `init` / `start` / `destroy`; no install / enable / disable hooks) — both named only to warn, and the wrong forms have several spellings (method, property, call site), so no single narrowing holds | reference rephrased: "a `data:*` kernel hook registers and never fires", "No install / enable / disable hooks."; assertions unchanged |
| 4 | `@objectstack/adapter-` | `SKILL.md` line 275 ("There are **no** `@objectstack/adapter-*` packages") — named only to warn; narrowing to a single-quoted import would miss the double-quoted `package.json` dependency form | reference rephrased: "no `adapter-*` packages exist"; assertion unchanged |
| 7 | `role:`, `admin_full_access` | `DemoStaffSchema` refuses `role` as an alias of `position` (`packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` line 71); `SKILL.md` lines 438–440 ("a platform set such as `admin_full_access` is refused") — `role:` is already the key spelling; `admin_full_access` is a value with the same quote-style leak as eval 4 | reference names the alias as `role` (no colon) and says "no platform set" (the skill's own term); assertions unchanged |

- No assertion deleted, no case added or removed. Evals 3, 5, 6, 8 and 9, including the predecessor PR #27426 (merged `501bfc69`) eval 9, are unchanged byte for byte.
- `.changeset/27455-platform-eval-self-agreement.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, carrying the two declaration lines above.
- Not done, by ruling (triage comment 6491392918): no lint over evals — a self-check that would catch the class is a separate card. The file's ceiling row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not lowered either: that script is outside this card's declared file surface, so the new headroom (14 tokens) is reported here, not spent or banked.

## Tests

No test file changes: nothing in the repo executes this fixture; its consumer is the skills eval grader that applies `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` as substrings to an answer (the card's repro models that). The diff touches no workspace package, so no package build or test is owed (local verification scope ① and ② are empty).

## Acceptance notes

Tier H (`skills/**`) readings, both required:

- Changed file, whole file: 95 → 95 lines; 6756 → 6703 bytes; 1689 → 1676 tokens (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, ceiling 1690 unchanged, headroom 1 → 14).
- Whole package: `skills/objectstack-platform/**` 88041 → 87988 bytes; the sum of every `skills/*/SKILL.md` 4610 → 4610 lines (no SKILL.md touched); the whole authored bundle 207870 → 207857 tokens (ceiling sum 217474).

Observations, noted and not filed:

- No gate in either root checks a `must_not_contain` string against the same case's `expected_output` (`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` deliberately shape-checks `must_not_contain` only). Triage ruled that lint a separate card; the seat carries it.
- Eval 3 also refuses `@objectstack/adapter-`; its answer never spelled the string, so it is untouched.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 42 commands from the diff against the merge base `ded67bfb`. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 37 exit 0; 5 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET — no package `dist/` in the tree; the diff touches no package, so the closure build is not owed locally and CI runs these): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. - Control-byte self-scan over both touched files: none; `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
- Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
